tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/na mo gu ra be/rang gi mdun du seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dbyer med sku mdo
༄༅/ /zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/na mo gu ra be/rang gi mdun du seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dbyer med sku mdo

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ra be/ rang gi mdun du seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dbyer med sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa la snyoms par 'jug pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas brkyang gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /

maṇḍal rgyas bsdus mang nyung ci rigs dang*/ de nas bstod pa ci shes dang*/ oṃ rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo hūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ chgai oṃ/ bzlas pa'o/ / arghaṃ sogs dang bstod pa bya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badzri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ / sogs kyi bum dbang*/ yab yum byang sems lce thog tu gnang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs kyis gsang dbang*/ phyag rgya btad/ dga' gter gnas ster sogs/ snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā ba atma ko3haṃ/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ ye shes 'di ni sogs dbang bzhi pa'o/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla/ bzod par gsol/ bla ma rang la thim/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis bya'o/ /bde mchog lhan skyes kyi gnas su yi dam gang mos skabs sbyar rig par bya'o/ /yang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum po re re dang*/ gsum car gyi 'od zer rang la stim pa la dbang bzhir byed pa yang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gnad chen po yod la/ dbang bzhi dang chos mtshungs tsam yin gyis/ dbang dngos kyi cho ga ma yin no/ / bla ma 'od du zhu/ smin mtshams sogs gnas bzhir khyab pas dbang bzhi thob par bsam pa yang dbang dngos ma yin kyang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyong ba la gnad che zhing*/ dga' ba bzhi 'char bar byin gyis brlabs pas bde stong sgom pa la bsngags pa zhig go /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yig chung ste dang po'o// bkra shis/ /athi+-i// na mo gu ra be/ lam bsgom pa la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rnam par dag pa cig gal che/ zhi gnas la sems gnas thabs dgu/ nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad la brten nas/ sems gsal ngar can shin tu dwangs pa la/ rnam rtog gi g.yo ba med par rtse gcig tu gnas pa zhig dang*/

lhag mthong la/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i lta ba go ba tsam ma lus pa'i myong ba thon pa zhig dgos/ 'di ma byung na sems gnas pa than thun gyi mtshams shig nas rtsa bral du ngo sprod de/ dbang po rab re re gnyis gnyis ma gtogs/ bon dang*/ ha shang mahā ya na'i lugs kyi sgom du 'gro ba mang*/ de mu stegs pa rab kyi ting nge 'dzin las dma' ba yin/ zhi lhag rnam dag cig yod na/ /de ma bor ba'i ngang nas gang shar ma bcos pa lam du byed pa btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa 'di/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag grub chen rnams kyi lugs yin/ spyir zhi lhag bzang po thun mong ba de/ tshe ril bsgoms kyang*/ rkyen la brten nas 'phel 'grib sna tshogs byed pa zhig 'ong ba/ de ma bcos pa lam du byed pa 'dis zin na/ rkyen gang gi yang 'gyur ba med pa zhig 'phral du 'grub pa yin/ de tsam na rtsa bral du song ba yin no/ /'ga' zhig zhi lhag gi gzhung lam la 'gro mi dgos/ deng phyag rgya chen po seng lam pa yin/ grub thob 'ga' zhig ngo sprod tshig res grol ba bzhin no zer te/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag de rnams/ sngon bsgoms pa'i nus pa rkyen des sad nas grol ba yin mod kyi/ las dang po pa la mi rung*/ rnal 'byor ma bi na sa/ chu bum chags pa mthong bas grol ba dang 'dra ste/ gang zag phal pa rnams/ chu bum pas/ stong gsum zhig pa mthong yang ga la grol/ 'on kyang ma bcos pa lam du byed pa 'di ma nor ba zhig byung na/ than thun skyangs kyang chos brgyad rags pa mgo snyoms nus pa zhig 'dug mod kyi/ da lta phal cher/ bon lugs su ngo sprad pas/ nyi ma skyel ba dang mi tshe 'phul ba tsam du 'gro yin snang bas/ 'di'i gnad ma 'chugs pa zhig lag tu blang ba'i tshul la/ dang por sems gnas pa gal che zhing*/ dmigs rten gang la 'jog kyang*/ ched 'dzin dang bral zhing*/ rtse gcig tu 'dril ba zhig dgos/ dmigs pa yang phyi la mi bya bar sems la sems 'jog pa'o/

/gnas dang lus gnad lta stangs gcig la sems brtan nas de rnams nges med du byas la sems sngar bzhin slab/ sgom du ci yang med pa la yengs su brdul tsam med par bya/ de nas phyi rol gyi gzugs sgra la sogs pa'i snang ba gang shar gyi 'char sgo lam me ba de la/ sngar bzhin skyong*/ de nas spyod lam thams cad la bsre zhing na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i ngo bor snang ba/ 'char sgo lhang lhang ba de'i ngo bo la sngar bzhin bskyangs/ nyin mo sgom rgyun mi chad du song ba'i tshe/ 'dun pa cung zad kyi khyad par gyis/ mtshan mo gnyid mthug po dang*/ rmi lam du'ang 'ong bas/ zhi gnas khor yug tu 'gro zhing*/ de thams cad la dran pa skyong ba gal che ba yin no/ /sems gnas pa thun mong ma yin pa'i yig chung ste gnyis pa'o/ /athi+-i //na mo gu ra be/ sems gnas pa de la brtan pa thob nas/ man ngag ltar skye 'gags gnas gsum legs par rtsal bas/ snang tsam la gang du yang ma grub pa zhig 'ong ste/ de la mnyam par 'jog de'i rtsi ma yal ba zhig dgos pas/ yang nas yang du 'phro bcad de skyar gin sgom pa la gal che'o/ /de yang snga ma bzhi'i mnyam rjes thams cad la rtsal zhing sre bar bya'o/ /thams cad la sre nus shing*/ rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i tshe ma bcos pa lam du byed pa yin te/ bzang ngan 'char sgo ci byung yang*/ shar tsam nyid nas/ rang gi rang shes shing*/ shes tsam nyid nas ngo bo skye 'gag 'gro 'ong med pa/ go ba tsam min par lhag ge mthong ba gcig 'ong ste/ gong snang thams cad rang ngos nas rkang tshugs tshugs 'dra ba 'di/ yul med du bud kyang 'char sgo thams cad 'gags pa med pa zhig 'byung ngo*/ /de'i tshe ched gnyer gyi mi slod mi sgrim ched gtad mi sgom mi 'chos/ gang shar de nyid la bzo bcos byed don med/ yang don gal po che sems pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi don phra mo la dpyod pa sogs la'ang*/ de dang de'i 'char sgo la ma bcos pa'i skyong tshul dgos shing de'i tshe sgom la nga bdag bral/

dgag rgyu dang sgrub rgyu ma snyed/ spang bya dang blang bya ro mnyam du song*/ 'char sgo thams cad 'char kyang*/ 'char bya 'char byed brnyed rgyu med par/ rang ngo rtsol med du shes pa zhig byung ba'i tshe/ rtsa ba bral ba zhes bya ba'am/ 'gyur ba med pa yin no/ /'di thob nas kyang rig pas dpyod pa dang*/ bskyed rim sogs spros bcas ji ltar mang gin rtsa bral las mi 'da' bas shin tu bogs che ba yin gyi/ nyon mongs ye shes su rlom shing*/ spros bcas kyi dge sbyor la sdang ba ni spangs blang 'dzol ba'i chos la log go /rtsa bral gyi yig chung ste gsum pa'o/ /athi+-i/ /na mo gu ra be/ khyad par dug lnga lam 'khyer la/ 'jig rten phal pa rnams/ dug lnga rang dgar spyad pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ pha rol du phyin pa las/ byams pa la sogs pas mgo gnon/ stong pa nyid bsgoms pas rtsa ba nas spong par bshad cing*/ yang snying rje la sogs pas thabs mkhas 'ga' zhig gis lam du byed pa theg chen thams cad las 'byung*/ rnal 'byor bla med ma gtogs/ sngags gzhan rnams kyang de dang phal cher 'dra/ bla med 'dir/ 'od gsal mi rtog pas/ gti mug lam du 'khyer ba dang*/ mngon spyod kyis zhe sdang dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal gyi nga rgyal dang*/ rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde ba la sogs pas 'dod chags ched du ma spangs par brten pas lam du gyur na spang bya rang dag tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir/ lta ba la brten nas dug lnga ma bcos lam du 'khyer tshul ni/ dper na/ sems 'dod chags kyi rnam par lam me shar ba'i tshe/ rang dga' mar song na skye bo phal pa'i sems dang 'dra/ ched kyi spong na thabs la mi mkhas/ des na chags yul/ chags mkhan/ chags tshul rang bzhin gyi grub pa med cing*/ brnyed rgyu med kyang*/ 'dod chags kyi 'char sgo ma 'gags pa de la skyon yon du mi lta/ las mi 'chol bar 'char sgo de ka la bzhag pa'i tshe/ 'dod chags rdo rje rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yin no/

/de bzhin du nyon mongs pa lnga char la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di la'ang rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rim pa gnyis 'ong ngo nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor ba/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gro don byed/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nyi zla lta bur 'gro don byed/ /chu bo lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /chu bo lta bur 'gro don byed/ /sa gzhi lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sa gzhi lta bur 'gro don byed/ /dug lnga gra zur ma chag kyang*/ /sman du 'gro ba ngo mtshar che/ /sngon chad dgra bo yin pa yang*/ /thabs kyi gnyen du khugs pa 'dra/ /'dod chags rdo rje la sogs pa'i yig chung ste bzhi pa'o/ /athi+-i/ na mo gu ra be/ lam rim pa gnyis las/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag rnams gzhan du shes par bya bas 'dir ma brjod/ lha'i rnam pa bsal ba dang gcig nga rgyal shugs drag pa dang gnyis/ rang bzhin med pa'i lta bas zin pa dang gsum rang lhar sgom pa gang la yang gal che/ bskyed rim du 'gro ba la de'i steng du skye shi bar do gsum sbyong byed dang*/ sku gsum lam khyer du song ba/ zhu bdes rgyas thebs pa rnams dgos/ rdzogs rim la gtum mo sgom na/ lus gnad sogs lag len ltar bya/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ phyi lus kyi stong ra dang bcas pa thun re re la/ lan gnyis brgya tsam re sgom zhing*/ thun bzhi byas la/ nyin zhag mang du sgom ste dmigs skor gnyis/ gzhan de dang 'dra ba la/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i yi ge re re gsal 'debs pa la dmigs skor re re/ me rlung gnyis la re re lag len ltar bum pa can byas la yi ge rnams gsal btab pa'i rjes su/ lte ba'i gtum mo kho na la sems 'dzin pa dmigs skor gcig 'khor lo bzhi 'bar ba'i re re/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong byed pa la gcig /dkar dmar 'dres pa dang po la gcig /'bar 'dzag gnyis ka sgom pa la gcig ste/ de nas de nyid rtag tu sgom mo/ /des rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad 'byung ngo*/

/gtum mo'i yig chung ste lnga pa'o/ /athi+-i/ na mo gu ra be/ bum pa can brtan pa'am/ cung zad myong ba thon nas/ lus gnad lag pa gnyis rkang pa'i bol la bcang pa lce spyang gi 'dug stangs byas la/ lag len bzhin/ rlung phyir bus la mnan/ 'thur sel then/ rtsa'i ka ba gzug par bya/ thog mar sgra med la slab ste thun gcig de nas ha dang haka dang hiṃ dang hriṃ dang*/ hūṃ gi sgra rnams la thun re re/ de nas steng rlung cung zad brngub cing thur sel 'dren pa la thun gcig 'di dag sgom pa'i tshe/ kha sbyor drag tu steng du drangs pa dang*/ spel nas sgom dgos shing*/ kha sbyor 'dren pa de nyid la yang dgos su skyong zhing*/ 'og gi lam gnyis snol ma'i sbyor ba yang nyin zhag mang du slab/ de dag la/ yang yang krug 'grems dang 'khrul 'khor mnad du che/ de nas hūṃ rings kyi srog nang du drangs shing*/ hūṃ thung gi thur sel steng du drangs/ phaṭa kyi sbyor bas sre ba ni hūṃ phaṭa kyi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ 'di shin tu gal che ba yin/ de nas khams 'gyur ba 'gag pa/ ril ba zhabs tshags can gyi sbyor ba yang goms par bya/ thog mar re re la ci rigs par goms nas/ bum pa can la gzhi byas te sbyar ba gzhan de rnams kyang thun bzhir ma chag par sgoms/ gsang ba'i rlung kha sbyor rgyun ma chad par bya/ gnad ma 'chugs par sgom na zla ba drug gam/ lo tsam sgom pas/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnad 'chugs pa'i rlung sbyor gyis ni mi tshe la'ang yon tan mi skyed par snang ngo*/ /rlung sbyor gyi yig chung ste drug pa'o/ /athi+-i/ na mo gu ra be/ gal te rmi lam bzung bar 'dod na/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ yi ge oṃ dmar po la sems gtad cing*/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ thun re re la dmigs pa gsal 'debs thengs dang*/ 'dun pa stong ba lan lnga brgya tsam bya'o/ thun mtshams thams cad du rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu btang*/

nyal ba'i tshe oṃ la sems gtad pas/ rmi lam 'phral du zin pa yin no/ /rmi lam sgom pa la rlung gnad du che/ rmi lam sbyangs pa/ snang ba sna tshogs su bsgyur ba ni/ gzhan dang mthun la nyin par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu bskyed nas/ 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo'i dus rmi lam shar yang*/ slar 'od gsal du 'jug pa yin no/ /nyin par rmi lam zin pa brtan pos/ nyin par snang ba sgyu ma rtag tu bsgoms pas/ rmi lam thams cad lha skur sgyur nus pa yin no/ /lha sku 'od gsal du ldang 'jug gi dmigs pa yang yang bsgoms pas/ rmi lam gyi lha sku rang shar 'byung ba yin no/ /rmi lam yig chung ste bdun pa'o/ /athi+-i/ na mo gu ra be/ snang ba sgyu ma la/ las dang po pa dang*/ brtan pa thob pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtum mo'am las rgya la sogs pa'i bde stong gi myong ba cung zad yod na rab/ med na stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyi bskyed nas/ bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sgom/ gsal snang cung zad thob nas snang ba thams cad la gsal snang dang bden med kyi 'dun pa spros nas/ yang bdag nyid la bsdu ba sogs goms par bya'o/ /'dir bskyed rim dang thun mong pa yin yang rdzogs rim gyi sgyur 'gyur ba la shin tu zab bo/ / gnyis pa ni/ bde stong gi ye shes skye khar 'phen pa btang bas/ de sad pa dang lha skur rang shar dus snyam yod pa yin te/ de yang bde stong gi nyams skyes pa na 'phen pa btang ste lha sku stong par stim/ sad pa na rnam rtog gzhan gyi bar ma chod par lha bskyed nas spro bsdu dang*/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyong ba yang yang goms pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /'di gsang 'dus rim lnga'i bdag byin brlab pa dang mi gcig lus dben dang don gcig kyang*/ sgyu lus kyi tha snyad mi 'gal zhing*/ sad rmi gnyis ka'i dge sbyor la gal che'o/ /sgyu lus kyi yig chung ste brgyad pa'o/ /athi+-i/

/na mo gu ra be/ las dang po pa'i 'od gsal sgom par 'dod na/ snying kha chos 'khor gyi lte bar/ hūṃ sngon po'am/ thig le la sems drag tu gtad la yun ring du sgom/ mtshan mo yang*/ de ka'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe na yang dmigs pa dang dran 'dzin bya/ ha cang grims grags na gnyid du mi 'gro/ lhod grags na mi zin pas ran pa'i skyong lugs bya/ thim rim than thun dang 'dres pa'i ci rigs zin na/ snang ba gzhan thams cad rjes gzhig gi bsdus nas/ chos 'khor tsam dmigs nas sgom/ de yang bsdus nas hūṃ tsam dang*/ nā da tsam dang*/ stong pa la rtse gcig tu gtod pa rnams re re la zhag mang du byas te nyin par sgom zhing*/ mtshan mo'ang de dang des mtshon/ phyi ma 'di rnams la lus kyi stong sa ma 'chugs pa gal che/ thams cad la brten lha sku dang ldang ba na yang*/ lha skur ldang ba gal che/ 'od gsal gyi yig chung ste dgu pa'o/ /athi+-i //na mo gu ra be/ spyir dgyes rdor sogs spyi'i lugs kyi/ sad dus rlung sems lte bar gnas/ gnyis mthug la snying khar/ rmi lam la mgrin par/ snyoms 'jug gi tshe spyi bor gnas par gsungs/ dus 'khor las/ thog mtha' gnyis go zlog tu 'byung zhes mkhas pa rnams gsungs/ dus 'khor las kyang thur sel gyi dbang du byas na/ lte ba sad dus su bshad cing*/ steng gi dbang du byas pa la yang spyi bo sad dus su bshad pa med/ dpral ba sad dus su bshad pa yin/ lte ba la yas mas kyi cha gnyis yod pas mi 'gal ces bla ma lho phyogs pas gsungs*/ de'i gnad kas nor bu dang snying khar 'od gsal/ gsang ba dang mgrin par rmi lam/ lte ba dang spyi bor yas babs dang mas brtan gyi lhan skyes sogs sgom pa yin/ lhan skyes de sgom pa la rtog can rnal 'byor la brten pa gtum mo'o/ /chags can 'og sgo la brten pa la/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob nas sgrub pa ni gtso bo yin la/

cung zad nus pa thob nas/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba thob pa'i phyir brten pa'ang yod de/ gang ltar yang*/ lta ba la cung zad myong ba thon pa dang*/ lha sku'i gsal snang ngam/ ma mtha' yang mos pa brtan po dang*/ rlung sogs man ngag gi gnad la goms pa'i yid brtan thub pa cig tha mar yang dgos pa yin no/ /'di la thog mar yid kyi phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas gsang ba'i phyag rgya la bslab/ de nas las kyi phyag rgya'i gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ phyi'i reg bya rnams la rim gyis bslab/ de nas rdo rje dang padma mnyam par sbyar bas kur ma'i 'gros kyis 'khor lo bzhir dga' ba bzhi so sor skye ba la rim gyi bslab/ de yang*/ dbab dang gzung dang zlog dang khyab/ /rlung dang stong par sre ba la/ /shin tu 'bad nas bsgom par bya/ /rtsa 'tshol ba sogs gnad che zhing*/ /lta bas ma zin ngan song rgyu/ /'dod chen khu ba myur 'dzag pa/ /de la dngos grub mi byung zhes/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ nga yi rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di/ /bka' las 'da' bar ma byed cig /byang chub sems ni lhung 'gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams pas dmyal bar lhung*/ /tshe 'di sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung*/ /bde ba nyams par mi bya'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i yig chung ste bcu pa'o/ /athi+-i/ /na mo gu ra be/ tha mal gyi sgo dgag pa 'di ni/ rdzogs rim gang gi mngon du sgom kyang*/ shin tu bzang ba yin no/ /de la 'dis rlung nang du zlog dbang po rnams kyi nad sel/ byang chub kyi sems sgo thams cad nas 'ching*/ yan lag gi rlung dul/ mngon par shes pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no/ /tha mal gyi sgo dgag pa'i yi ge rgyas pa ni/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ kṣuṃ brtsegs pa/ smin mtshams su haṃ hūṃ/ lce'i rtsa bar suṃ/ mgrin par*/ mig la hūṃ/ rna ba dang*/ sna bug la yuṃ/ lte ba dang 'og sgo gnyis su / phrag pa gnyis su / snying khar*/ yi ge bzhi brtsegs rnams mgo nang stan nyal stabs su 'god par rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin 'grub na shin tu mthu che ba yin/

de tsam ma 'grub na gnas de rnams su thig le kha dog dkar po re re bkod/ de'i 'od zer dkar po mthug pos sgo de dang de brtan por bkag par bsam/ re re la yang zhag lnga lnga re bslab cing*/ de nas gnyis sdoms sogs la rim gyi bslab/ mthar thams cad gcig char gsal btab nas/ rlung nang du bzlog pa'i rtags byung byung sgom ste/ bum pa can dang sbyor dgos so/ /lus gnad kyang lce spyang gi 'dug stangs bzhin byed pa gdan bzhi'i dgongs pa yin/ de goms nas lte ba'i aṃ dmar po gsal btab/ de'i 'od kyi lus ky-i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rlung rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas aṃ la bsdus pa sgom pa ni/ khab byed bsdu ba ste/ nad thams cad zhi bar byed cing*/ rlung thim pa la yang gnad du che ba yin no/ /yi ge brgyad po rnams snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la bkod pas rtsa gnas gzhan gyi rlung bkag nas dbu mar 'jug pa sogs mang po gdan bzhi'i rgyud las 'byung ngo*// sgo dgag pa'i yig chung ste bcu gcig pa'o// na mo gu ra be/ gong du 'pho bar 'dod na 'pho ba'i lha ye shes dbang phyug mar bskyed pa'am/ yi dam gang yang rung bas/ bshad ma thag pa'i sgo dgag pa de nyid la nan tan du 'bad/ phyi nang gi rlung log pa'i rtags byung zhing bum pa can brtan na rab/ ma brtan kyang ci rigs bsgom pa la 'gal ba med de/ 'on kyang 'di la ni spel gyin sgom pa yin no/ /bum pa can ma brtan na/ gser gyi sgo 'byed nus pa dka' zhing*/ khyad par 'pho ba dang grong 'jug la dbang 'byor ba ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /des na bum pa can brtan brtan gyi bar bum can 'dod du mi rung ngo*/ /'pho ba rgyas par/ snying khar yi ge bdun 'god pa ste/ yum bzhi dang*/ hūṃ dang*/ hika kha dog sngon po rnams so/ /de tsam sgom mi nus na yi ge gsum la brten pas kyang chog ste/ hūṃ dang hi ki'o/ /de yang mi nus na hūṃ gcig pus chog go

/gang ltar na'ang chos 'khor 'dab brgyad kha thur stan gyi lte ba na rlung gi dkyil 'khor la yig mgo thur bstan du 'phyang ba/ lte ba'i aṃ gi me 'bar ste snying kha'i yi ge dang spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun pa'i 'bar 'dzag gi gtum mo sgom pa sngon du 'gro ba gal che ste/ sems brten gyi dkar dmar skyod pa la dkar dmar gzhi rgya 'bar 'dzag gal che ba yin no/ /dngos kyi dmigs pa ni/ aṃ dmar po'i 'od kyis snying kha la 'phog pas yi ge rnams dbu ma'i lam nas spyi bor 'phangs te spyi bo'i steng du cung zad mthon par bsam/ haṃ yi mthen cing ka yi 'phul/ padma'ang kha gyen la bstan/ rlung 'byung ba'i tshe hika nyi shu rtsa gcig gis steng du 'phang*/ brngub pa'i tshe ka hi snying khar dbab par bsam/ grong du 'jug pa dang*/ tshar gcad rjes 'dzin 'dir ma bkod/ sgo 'bring nas 'pho ba'i man ngag kyang shin tu mang bas ma bris/ 'pho ba'i yig chung ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ /athi+-i/ /na mo gu ra be/ gal te 'khrul 'khor byed 'dod na/ /'chi med grub pa la sogs bya/ /yang na thor bu ba rnams bsdu/ /lto ba skor dang ro stod bcu/ / mgo bo bskor zhing dgye dgu bya/ /steng du 'phar zhing 'og tu bdab/ / yan lag dkrug dang brkyang bskum bya/ /dang po srung shing srub par bya/ / gnyis pa rgya mtsho skyod par bya/ /gsum pa bsad pa nor lha gnyis/ /bzhi pa yan lag brkyangabaskum ste/ /phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing srid gsum skrag /sbyor ba drug ldan ri rab 'degs/ /gcan gzan skyug dang wa ltar snom/ /yi dwags 'dug stangs glang chen hing*/ /g.yang mo'i rgang dkrugs seṅge'i rtsal/ /hriṃ hriṃ seṅge rnam par

: brol [phrol] / /rjes chags : skre [ske ] rags 'khor lo bskor/ /zhags pa 'phangs dang rtsa mig bdab/ /nyi ma'i 'gros dang seṅge'i g.yal/ /glang chen bzhi 'phras bu chung lugs/ /bab bzhi 'phrab dang mi chen lugs/ /yan lag lnga sbyor bandha gnyis/ /gling bzhi gnad bor sgrad pa'i mtha'/ /rtsa bcing mig sogs 'khrul 'khor ro/ /'di rnams bya sla zhing gnad che ba dag go /'khrul 'khor gyi yig chung ste bcu gsum pa'o/ /athi+-i// na mo gu ra be/ rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa gang la yang*/ sems gtad pa tsam gyi rlung yon po yang mnyam rgyur thengs na/ dbu mar zhugs pa zhes bya/ dmigs pa gang la sems gtad pas/ sna sgor rgyu ba 'gags na gnas pa zhes bya/ khong rlung gi khengs pa bzhin yod pa yang yal zhing thim pa'i tshe/ thim pa zhes bya/ thim ma thag drod dang zhu bde skye/ bde drod ma byung na thim pa rnam dag ma yin/ drod la srab mthug dang*/ phyi nang dang*/ gnas gzhan du 'pho ba myur bul sogs kyi khyad par yod/ brtags lnga yang rlung thim pa'i tshe gtso bor 'byung ste/ 'ga' zhig rtags lnga dang*/ dkar lam shar ba sogs/ sems kyi khyad par gyi dper bzhed pa'ang yod/ 'on kyang rtags snang de rnams 'char ba yin te/ de la snang ba dkar lam 'jam pa dang bde ba'i rnam pa can du 'char/ mched pa dmar lam rtsub cing gsal ba thod dka' ba'i rnam pa can 'char/ thob pa nag lam rgyal ba dran med kyi rnam pa can 'byung*/ bzhi pa 'od gsal gsal zhing rig pa bde ba chen po'i rnam pa can 'byung*/ de rnams phyi ma phyi ma rnam rtog nub phul che zhing*/ myong ba ngos zin pa gal che/ de bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi phyogs mthun pa yin mod/ 'on kyang 'khor lo bzhir babs pa'i nyams myong gi dbang du byas na/ bde bar snang tsam gdong la ljid babs pa 'dra ba ni dga' ba rdzogs pa'i tshad yin/ snying khar lhang bas ni mchog dga' rdzogs lte bar shigs se 'byung bas khyad dga' rdzogs/

gsang bar mer gyi 'byung ba ni lhan skyes so/ /lugs bzlog la yang*/ gsang bar stong sang ba dang*/ lte bar sgring nge ba dang*/ snying kha khang ba dang*/ spyi bor sgrid chil ba dang bde ba dang zug ngu'i rnam pa can ci rigs su 'byung ba ni mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /dga' ba bzhi po 'di dag las dang po pa rnams la/ las kyi phyag rgya kho nas gsal bar mtshon la/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa man chad ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang gtum mos kyang gsal po mtshon nus so/ /dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig ma bzhi sbyor ba myong ba'i steng nas ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin du skad cig ma bcu drug sogs kyang ngos zin dgos la/ rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba'ang zhib tu shes dgos mod kyi rnam gzhag rnams/ bshad pa las shes shing*/ myong ba lag len ltos pas rtsad bcad par bya'o/ /nyams kyi yi chung ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /athi+-i/ /na mo gu ra be/ 'di'i lo rgyus zur du shes/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad 'di la rnam pa lnga ste/ kha sbyor gyi drang ba dang*/ lto ba phyir bskyed pas bogs dbyung ba dang*/ nang gi kha sbyor gyi bcud len cing nad gsal ba dang*/ glod cing skrad pa'i mtha' 'gyur ba 'gegs pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan gzug pa'i cho gas bogs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni steng rlung bsu ma cung zad bcug la/ thur sel dal bus drang ba dang*/ drag tu drang ba dang*/ dpe med par 'dren pa gsum/ thur sel gyi bsu ma bcug nas/ srog mnan pa dang*/ drag tu mnan pa dang*/ dpe med par mnan pa dang gsum mo/ /'di srog thur bsre ba la bsngags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung gnyis kha sbyar ba rgyab nas rlung mdun du drangs/ : sus [sug ] par sdig la lto ba phyir skyed pa dang*/ drag tu bskyed pa dang*/ dpe med par bskyed pa dang gsum mo/ /'di gong ma'i bogs 'don no/ /gsum pa ni/ lte bar kha sbyor drag tu byas la 'pho bar drangs/

der rtse gcig tu g.yo med du bzhag yang rgyab nas drangs te lto ba kha sbyar dang*/ drag tu kha sbyar dang*/ dpe med par kha sbyar dang gsum mo/ /'dis pho nad la sogs pa 'joms so/ /'di brtan na gang na sar/ kha sbyor de nyid drag tu byas pas sel lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ srin po'i lam phul ba dang*/ drag tu phul ba dang*/ dpe med par phul ba dang gsum mo/ /'dis ni thig le 'gag go /de'i bogs 'don du/ yan lag bzhi sgrad pa dang*/ drag tu sgrad pa dang*/ dpe med par sgrad pa gsum mo/ /'di la lus nya bzhi glod pa yin la/ 'dis kyang nad sel ba yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ steng rlung khong mnan tsam bya/ a long 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor bas/ rgyal mtshan gzug pa dang*/ drag tu gzug pa dang*/ dpe med par gzug pa dang gsum mo/ /'di la nya bzhi sgrim bzhin khro bo ltar bsdus/ skabs 'gar lto ba 'gyur bya/ bde ba'i bogs 'don no/ /dang po la/ lha dkar po zhi ba/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya can zhabs kyi rtse btsugs pa gcig sgom/ lus kyang bya rog gi 'dug stangs bya/ gnyis pa la/ ser po brjid pa la bzhugs pa gcig sgom/ lus gnad lag pad pus mo la 'gebs/ gsum pa la/ lha mo nag mo khros pa gcig sgom/ lus thab 'gal bya/ bzhi pa la/ lha ljang khu spyan gyen du gzigs pa gcig gi sna'i nang du/ du ba dmar ser yal le ba sgom/ lnga pa la/ lha dmar po g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon dril bu 'khrol ba gcig sgom/ de gnyis la lus gnad nges pa med/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi yig chung ste bco lnga pa'o/ /athi+-i //na mo gu ra be/ rlung rang 'gag dang*/ shes pa gnam du 'phang pa dang*/ nam mkha' la yas pa dang*/ spyi bor gtad pa dang*/ gzo med dang*/ bde ba'i ngo bo dmigs gtad zhig pa rnams bzung ba'i man ngag go /rgya mtsho'i ri rab la cer ba dang*/ dar chen rang gnas su 'phyar/ gling bzhi dbang du bsdus/ bya rgod nam mkhar spur/ ri rab rtse mo dgug

shes pa spyi bor gtad la hūṃ phaṭa kyi mda' gzhus 'phang ba ni zlog pa'i man ngag go /lus 'ja' tshon ltar ban bun song bar bsam pa ni/ khyab pa'i man ngag go /dpral bar mig dmar po 'byed 'dzum byed pa la bsams pas 'gyur ba dal bar 'gyur ro/ /e re'i thal ba dang*/ dha du ras byugs pas kyang ngo*/ /'ga' zhig sor mos skud pa gnon pa dang*/ rdzas kyi sgo nas 'gyur ba rengs par byed pa ni thabs sdugs so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las mang du gsungs pa'i las tshogs tsam la dgongs pa yin no/ /man ngag gi gnad thun mong pa'i yig chung ste bcu drug go/ / man ngag 'di rnams skal ba dang ldan pa dag gi nyams su longs shig rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di la 'grub pa'i thabs chen po bla na med pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying byung ba yin no/ /gnad dang lag len bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas byin rlabs shing*/ / dkyil 'khor slob dpon chen por gyur/ /lhas byin rlabs pa'i mtshan ma thob/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i sems dang ldan/ /de yi man ngag ji lta bar/ /mngon sum du ni rtogs na yang*/ /re zhig yi ger ma bris pa/ /deng 'dir yig chung so sor bkod/ /sdom pas yi ge chen por song*/ /dbang chog gsang ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ /lam gyi chings rnams shes dgos so/ /'di ni gsang ba chen po yin/ /zab lam bka' rgya ma'i yi ge 'di rnams kyang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer lngar nye ba la/ slob ma zab don gnyer ba rnams kyi don du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dad ldan grags pa bzang po'o/ /yi ge 'di ci thod thod ma ston cig// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zab lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs/ - PAGE 200 -- PAGE 201 - - PAGE 184 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
